prompt: The storm holds its breath. Name the Broker — the hand behind the hollow frame.

suspects.label: Elias Vane — the painter who lived

wrongLine: Margo lowers her notebook. 'Look at the pins again, Halloway. Who could re-tension a cradle only its inventor understood?'

confrontation.speaker: halloway
confrontation.en: WHO: Ottilie Marsh — Nachtigall — founding conservator, the cartographer's daughter, the sitter in the painting.

confrontation.speaker: halloway
confrontation.en: MOTIVE: In 1921 the board spent her name and kept her painting. In 1926 the Belmont bought a forgery of her own face — and called it a miracle. She meant to hold the truth level until someone else could.

confrontation.speaker: halloway
confrontation.en: METHOD: A duplicate frame built from Casal's own gilt blank; the cradle only its designer could re-tension; Finch bought for the exact shape of his debt; the theater crate stamped with a forged mark.

confrontation.speaker: halloway
confrontation.en: TIMELINE: Oct 11 — 23:15, the freight tram to Clocktower Lane; forty minutes for the swap. 'Thirty-nine,' she corrects. 'The cradle releases in four. I designed it.'

confrontation.speaker: halloway
confrontation.en: KEY CONTRADICTION: A seal retired in 1921, 'not recovered', signing transfer papers in 1927 — a woman inside the Belmont for six years without setting foot in it.

confrontation.speaker: halloway
confrontation.en: CRITICAL EVIDENCE: the blueprint she drew, the waybill on her father's pass, the minute that spent her name, the dossier from the floor safe, the stretcher bar with fresh tack holes — and the papers Finch kept.

confrontation.speaker: ottilie
confrontation.en: Well argued. My colleagues taught you patience; the storm taught you timing. — Elias. Come in out of the rain. Sign your work.

confrontation.speaker: narration
confrontation.en: Vane signs the crated copy in front of witnesses: 'a Vane, after Vane.' The nightingale returns the brooch to her collar with her own hand.

confrontation.speaker: ottilie
confrontation.en: Which painting will you give them, detective? The one that's real, or the one that's true?

flavorChoice.dry: By the book: the original goes home under warrant, the copy into evidence, and every name onto the record — including the ones that deserve apologies.
flavorChoice.warm: By the heart: the original goes home in her frame, the copy keeps its signature, and the record notes that some crimes are grief with excellent paperwork.

resolution.speaker: narration
resolution.en: Adele and Holt arrive with the storm's last act. Surrender is negotiated standing up, like professionals.

resolution.speaker: ottilie
resolution.en: The frame was never a decoy, little wren. I built it true to her dimensions. It was a promise.

resolution.speaker: margo
resolution.en: Case closed, Halloway. I'll write every fact and no painter. Let the unnamed master stay a master.
